verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a hosted AI app builder, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out control. The nearby privacy and security material (security scanners, row level security, enterprise audit logs) covers different features and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
